related.title: Kubernetes 投影 token：輪替、重讀與殘留期限
related.titleEn: Kubernetes projected tokens: rotation, rereading and stale lifetimes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：420與240秒可重算，scope只縮不增，subject和actor均可追溯；錯受眾及超期限的合成token一律拒絕。 交付delegation-chain.json、scope交集表及420/240秒時間線；標明這是本地驗收政策而非RFC通用強制期限。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 420 and 240 seconds, ensure scopes only narrow, and trace both subject and actor. Reject synthetic tokens with wrong audiences or lifetimes exceeding the local bound. Deliver delegation-chain.json, scope-intersection rows and 420/240-second timelines. Clearly identify the lifetime rule as local acceptance policy rather than a universal RFC-mandated duration.
related.difference: 以合成t0、expiry、檔案更新與應用重讀事件建立時間線；區分token audience與Pod綁定，不把此練習套用到永久Secret token。
related.differenceEn: Build a synthetic timeline of issuance, expiry, file replacement and application rereading. Record audience and Pod binding separately, and do not apply this exercise to long-lived Secret-based tokens.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地政策要求新token剩餘時間不超過輸入token、服務上限與工作需求三者最小值；scope另取明確允許交集，時間短不會自動修正過寬scope。 輸入token剩餘900秒、服務上限600秒、工作需求420秒；第二情境工作需求保持420，但輸入token只剩240秒。 可委派期限min(900,600,420)=420秒；變更後min(240,600,420)=240秒。到期以共同觀測時刻計算。
在本課短TTL情境，80%TTL輪替觸發早於24小時條件；以到期減觸發與重讀延遲估算餘裕。觸發時刻不是保證完成時刻。 TTL為3600秒，假設輪替即刻成功，程序120秒後重讀；改變情境把重讀延遲增為480秒，其他條件不變。 觸發t=2880秒，基準餘裕3600−2880−120=600秒；延遲後3600−2880−480=240秒。網路重試需另外扣除。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy bounds new-token remaining lifetime by the minimum of input lifetime, service cap and task need. Scope is separately intersected with explicit permissions; short lifetime does not repair excessive scope. The input token has 900 seconds remaining, the service cap is 600 and task need is 420. In the changed fixture task need stays 420 while input remaining lifetime falls to 240 seconds. Delegated lifetime is min(900, 600, 420)=420 seconds, falling to 240 when the input lifetime falls. Compute all remaining lifetimes against the same observation instant.

For the short TTL used here, the 80%-of-TTL trigger precedes the 24-hour condition. Estimate margin by subtracting trigger time and reread delay from expiry; a trigger is not a guarantee of completed renewal. Use a 3600-second TTL, assume immediate successful renewal at the trigger, and reread 120 seconds later. The changed fixture increases reread delay to 480 seconds with other conditions unchanged. Trigger time is 2880 seconds; margin is 3600−2880−120=600 seconds, falling to 240 with delayed rereading. Network retries would require an additional, separately stated deduction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RATS：證據、評估結果與政策版本的新鮮度
related.titleEn: RATS: freshness of evidence, appraisal results and policy revisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：420與240秒可重算，scope只縮不增，subject和actor均可追溯；錯受眾及超期限的合成token一律拒絕。 交付delegation-chain.json、scope交集表及420/240秒時間線；標明這是本地驗收政策而非RFC通用強制期限。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 420 and 240 seconds, ensure scopes only narrow, and trace both subject and actor. Reject synthetic tokens with wrong audiences or lifetimes exceeding the local bound. Deliver delegation-chain.json, scope-intersection rows and 420/240-second timelines. Clearly identify the lifetime rule as local acceptance policy rather than a universal RFC-mandated duration.
related.difference: 建立證據時間、評估時間、結果到期及政策修訂識別；加入有效簽章但舊政策、過期證據及錯受眾結果，分別標示哪個角色應拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Build evidence-time, appraisal-time, result-expiry and policy-revision fields. Add a valid signature under an obsolete policy, old evidence and a wrong-audience result, identifying the actor responsible for each rejection.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地政策要求新token剩餘時間不超過輸入token、服務上限與工作需求三者最小值；scope另取明確允許交集，時間短不會自動修正過寬scope。 輸入token剩餘900秒、服務上限600秒、工作需求420秒；第二情境工作需求保持420，但輸入token只剩240秒。 可委派期限min(900,600,420)=420秒；變更後min(240,600,420)=240秒。到期以共同觀測時刻計算。
本課允許證據最長300秒，結果最長120秒；服務可用餘裕取兩項剩餘值最小者。這是本地依賴方政策，RATS架構不替所有部署指定這些秒數。 觀測時證據年齡180秒、結果年齡30秒，政策版本與受眾皆相符；保持四個時間來源可追溯而非混用本機檔案mtime。 餘裕min(300−180,120−30)=90秒；證據年齡增至260秒而結果年齡不變時，餘裕變40秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local policy bounds new-token remaining lifetime by the minimum of input lifetime, service cap and task need. Scope is separately intersected with explicit permissions; short lifetime does not repair excessive scope. The input token has 900 seconds remaining, the service cap is 600 and task need is 420. In the changed fixture task need stays 420 while input remaining lifetime falls to 240 seconds. Delegated lifetime is min(900, 600, 420)=420 seconds, falling to 240 when the input lifetime falls. Compute all remaining lifetimes against the same observation instant.

The local policy permits evidence age up to 300 seconds and result age up to 120. Usable margin is the smaller remainder. These are relying-party choices; the RATS architecture does not mandate these durations for every deployment. At observation, evidence age is 180 seconds and result age is 30, with matching policy revision and audience. Keep the time sources traceable instead of substituting local file modification times for authenticated claims. Margin is min(300−180, 120−30)=90 seconds. Increasing evidence age to 260 while keeping result age fixed leaves 40 seconds, revealing the evidence limit as the new bottleneck.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
